scripts.check: vp run check:ts && vp run check:py
scripts.check:fix: vp run check:ts --fix && vp run check:py:fix
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run ty check
scripts.check:py:fix: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . && uv run ty check
scripts.test: vp run test:ts && vp run test:py
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev
scripts.ci: vp run check && vp run check:generated && vp run test && vp run -r build
